mapper.select: SELECT S.stuno AS stuNo, S.name AS name, S.grade AS grade, D.dname AS dName, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(S.jumin, 7, 1) = '1' THEN '남성' WHEN SUBSTR(S.jumin, 7, 1) = '2' THEN '여성' END AS gender FROM STU S LEFT OUTER JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON S.deptno1 = D.deptno
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STU (stuno, name, grade, jumin, id) VALUES ( #{stuNo}, #{name}, #{grade}, #{jumin}, #{stuId} )
